# TextureFrames

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TextureFrames:Int32 texture:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `texture` | In | Int32 | required | The texture to ask about. |

**Returns:** The number of frames, at least 1.

## Description

Says how many frames a texture has: more than one for a texture from [CreateTexture](CreateTexture) with frames, from [LoadAnimTexture](LoadAnimTexture), or from an animated picture file. Any other texture has 1. Choose the frame to show with the frame argument of [EntityTexture](EntityTexture) or [BrushTexture](BrushTexture).

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals cannot ask this.
